title: GranularGPT: Natural-Language-Driven End-to-End Discrete Element Method Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.20551v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete element method (DEM) simulations are widely used to investigate granular and particulate systems, but their application often requires specialized expertise in particle physics, numerical modelling, and simulation post-processing. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to simplify these workflows by enabling users to interact with simulation tools through natural language. This study offers GranularGPT, an LLM-assisted agentic framework for end-to-end DEM simulation workflows, from natural-language problem descriptions to simulation execution and automated post-processing. The framework enables users to generate DEM simulation cases, execute and monitor simulations, and automatically extract and report physical and process-level metrics. tldr: 提出了GranularGPT，一个基于大型语言模型的智能体框架，用户仅需通过自然语言即可完成从问题描述、模拟执行到自动化后处理的端到端离散元方法（DEM）模拟全流程，在60个案例中取得了91.7%的模拟成功率。
en_tdlr: GranularGPT is an LLM-assisted agentic framework that enables end-to-end DEM simulations driven by natural language—from problem description to simulation execution and automated post-processing—achieving a 91.7% simulation success rate across 60 cases.
